title: Learning What Matters: Supervising Global Context Pruning with Causal Evidence Sets
abstract: arXiv:2607.21692v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pruning a long context means committing to the blocks a model will keep, and the usual selector is distilled from a dense teacher's attention. That assumes attention shows which context the answer depends on. We test the assumption on retrieval tasks where the evidence is known exactly, by masking context and measuring whether the answer changes. Attention and causal dependence disagree. Teachers attend to outdated facts that the answer does not depend on, and they attend differently across training runs that use the same evidence. Selectors trained on that attention copy both failures. On a multi-hop retrieval task, a selector distilled from attention routes at 36% to 98% depending on the training run. The same selector trained on causal evidence sets reaches 99% or better on every run. Dense accuracy does not tell the teachers apart. Masking the frozen teacher recovers the causal sets of these tasks without annotations. Froze

translated_title: 学习何为重要：用因果证据集监督全局上下文剪枝
translated_abstract: 剪枝长上下文意味着决定模型将保留哪些文本块，而通常的选择器是从稠密教师模型的注意力中蒸馏出来的。这隐含了一个假设：注意力能够显示答案依赖于哪些上下文。我们在证据完全已知的检索任务上检验这一假设，方法是通过遮蔽上下文并测量答案是否改变。结果表明，注意力与因果依赖并不一致。教师模型会关注答案并不依赖的过时事实，而且在使用相同证据的不同训练轮次中，它们的注意力分布也不相同。基于这种注意力训练的选择器会复制这两种失败。在一个多跳检索任务上，从注意力蒸馏的选择器的路由准确率根据训练轮次的不同在36%到98%之间波动；而基于因果证据集训练的同一选择器在每次运行中都达到99%或更高。稠密准确率无法将这些教师模型区分开来。对冻结的教师模型进行遮蔽，可以在无需标注的情况下恢复这些任务的因果证据集。
tldr: 该论文发现注意力蒸馏并不能可靠反映答案的真实因果依赖，提出通过遮蔽冻结教师模型自动构建因果证据集来监督全局上下文剪枝，使选择器在多跳检索任务上稳定达到99%以上的准确率。
en_tdlr: Attention distillation fails to reflect true causal dependence; supervising global context pruning with causal evidence sets—recovered automatically by masking the frozen teacher—achieves stable 99%+ routing accuracy on multi-hop retrieval, versus 36–98% for attention-distilled selectors.
